input: Non-sensitive component proposal input reaches the original production card renderer through a conditional Debugger breakpoint. No provider response is replaced.

assertions.condition: sandbox remains allow-scripts; frame inspection uses a separately attached CDP target
frame scheme follows Material; frame height equals section height; no horizontal overflow or inner vertical scroll

Default matrix uses 1200 newlines within 4000 characters. Actual trusted Home, ArrowDown, PageDown and End keydown events and scroll positions are recorded; each scrolling step must move as expected and End must expose the final body line. Tab visits agree and cancel in both complete-entry paths.

Each complete-entry and presentation scene captures its starting event count, waits for new events, then requires exactly one new trusted cancel. The unchanged snapshot must fail that same assertion. Per-scene annotation localStorage, actual setItem count, marks and backend business writes/permits remain unchanged or zero.

All six viewport/theme cases use native Enter on the actual proposal button for cancellation and confirmation, verify the cancelled controller disables actions, and require exactly one local annotation write and one new trusted agree after confirmation. Per-case source events and screenshots are persisted.
exactly one choice selected, all choices locked after opening, action targets at least 44 CSS pixels
native computed foreground and background are parsed through Canvas; relative luminance contrast is at least 4.5
observed untrusted child click leaves zero local records; native click or keyboard Enter produces one record and matching mark
menu opens on selected option, ArrowUp moves focus, Escape closes menu and returns focus without closing panel; menu stays inside panel bounds
protected local editor retains scope, saves changed body and restores one record and mark after refresh
empty comment rejected before write; keyboard save, comment edit, reply save and browser refresh retain one comment and reply
production view receives explicit component inputs for pending/loading/warning/error/cancelled; busy, alert/status roles, disabled states, theme and maximum-length layout agree
isolated annotation service observes zero business mutations and permit requests
actual recorder collection and original JSON serialization preserve local blocking and public control
